findings.question: q-mechanical-technical-reasoning-pulleys-and-levers-0013
findings.quote: Check that a speeding-up block needs more than its weight, so the effort is larger than $640/2$.
findings.problem: The choice says only that the block is speeding up; neither it nor the stem says the block is rising. A block descending and speeding up accelerates downward, so its total upward rope force is less than 640 N and its effort is less than 320 N. The note incorrectly gives the opposite rule for this allowed case.
findings.fix: Specify that the block is rising and speeding up in the choice, and say that upward acceleration requires total upward force greater than its weight in the note.
